title: Mechawanienck (New Utrecht)
summary: Mechawanienck is a locality in Kings County. The name appears in a New Utrecht deed describing land running from Gouwanis across the hills toward the southeast side of Amersfoort, or Flatlands.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as the old path or trail, from language connected with old or ancient use and a road, walking road, or path.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names are variously expressions of identity, power, location, and culture.”

— Molly Williamson, Historical geographies of place naming: Colonial practices and beyond (2023), section 3, opening sentence
whereintheworld_content: Map location note: the pin is placed in the Flatlands/New Utrecht boundary landscape of Brooklyn to represent the deed locality; it is not an exact historic trail or boundary point.
